title: School Pickup Authorization
description: Authorizes a named individual to pick up a child from school on behalf of the issuer.

u.description: Salt, when the credential is issued private

i.description: Issuer: the identity that issued the credential

ri.description: The registry the credential is issued in, where its revocation is recorded

u.description: Salt, when the attributes are issued private

child_aid.description: Child's AID (if they have an Identity Agent)

is_recurring.description: True for standing authorization; false for one-off pickup

authorized_days.description: Days of week authorized (e.g. ["Monday","Wednesday"]). Empty means any day.

guardian_credential_id.description: SAID of the guardianship credential proving issuer's legal guardianship of the child. Enables chain-of-trust verification.

notes.description: Optional additional instructions for the school

oneOf.description: Edges: the credentials this one rests on, each by its identifier and schema
